description: ITSO-hosted campus generative AI interface. Chat history30 days then automatic deletion, export available; no promise about all security/vendor logs.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Open WebUI is a new platform provided by ITSO for supporting generative AI services. It provides a lot of enhanced features over the current HKUST GenAI platform and has the same level of chat data security protection.
HKUST staff and students (login at https://openwebui.hkust.edu.hk with your HKUST account and password)
All the chat retention period is 30-day. Outdated chat will be deleted automatically. User are allowed to export chat history.
Models vary in cost. Users can add more credits in their own expenses after they spend the $8 monthly credits.

universityName: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
description: Free for HKUST staff and students; institutional sign-in enables enterprise protection, not course permission.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Microsoft Copilot Chat is a free AI-powered assistant available to all HKUST staff and students, helping users brainstorm ideas, draft content, summarize information, write code, analyze data, and explore topics through natural language conversations.

When you sign in with your HKUST account, your data with Copilot Chat is protected by enterprise-grade data protection, ensuring that prompts and responses are handled securely and are not used to train foundation AI models.  More details can be found in the webpage, “Usage Tips on Microsoft Copilot Chat” below.

universityName: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
description: Individual students may subscribe; certain programmes/courses sponsor licences; staff departments may subscribe. Not staff-only.
howToObtain: Obtain the applicable EDU licence and sign in with HKUST account.
costToUser: Subscription or sponsorship applies; exact current student price not verified.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Student – Individual students can subscribe GE license for enhancing their learning experience. Please note certain academic programs or courses may provide or sponsor GE licenses for the students. Please visit this link for more details.
Staff – Departments or Schools interested subscribe GE for their staff members.  please contact cchelp@ust.hk for further subscription details.
Once you have secured your Google Gemini License, you can access it at https://gemini.ust.hk and sign-in with your HKUST account.

The Platform provides functionality similar to the public OpenAI ChatGPT, but with the chat data protection following our Cybersecurity guidelines.
